# Project Heron

Project Heron monitors the nesting colonies of herons, egrets and other
wading birds along the estuary. Counts run every week from April to August,
and the colony maps go to the regional bird trust.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[maren-solberg]]. Fieldwork runs from
[[kelmouth-site]], and the colonies are counted with the
[[mirror-array-mx4]].
